records.title: Allocations for appointment of teachers
details: Information for this part is being collected

records.title: Global Positioning System
details: Supplementary by Member regarding making the data relating to digital map available commercially to Indian companies and citizens, it was stated that this will be done very quickly.

records.title: Decline in priority sector accounts
details: The information regarding total amount disbursed through priority sector accounts during the March 1998 and March 2003 is being collected and to the extent available will be laid on the table of the House.

records.title: Functioning of DD and AIR under Prasar Bharati
details: A Review Committee on the functioning of Doordarshan and All India Radio and Expenditure Reforms Commission (ERC) have made recommendations on the rationalizing of the functions, activities and structure of the Ministry of I&B including AIR and Doordarshan. Action in pursuance of the reports of the Committees is under examination in consultation with prasar Bharati.

records.title: Assessment of NRC scheme
details: The National Resconstruction Corps scheme was approved for a period of 2 years only on pilot basis & its continuation is under consideration.

records.title: Establishment at the Central level for power sector
details: The information regarding the average annual budget of the each of the establishment at the set up at the Central level for the proper functioning of power sector in the country is being collected and will be laid on the Table of the House.

records.title: Programmes telecast on DD
details: The information regarding whether the programmes which are telecast on Doordarshan Kendra are procured from or produced by private sector organisations and the income generated from the advertisements and amount spent on the production or procurment on these programmes is being collected and will be laid on the Table of the House.

records.title: Production of coking coal
details: Supplementary by Member regarding the number of projects being conveived for the production of coking coal , the period of their pendency and their intended date of completion it was stated that the requisite information will be furnished.

records.title: Recommendations of GOM on subsidy
details: The Group of Minister was constituted to examine the proposal for formulation of 7th and 8th pricing periods and to consider the Expenditure Reforms Commission (ERC)`s report on rationalizing fertilizer subsidies and give its recommendations.

records.title: Purchasing electricity from electricity producing units by SEBs
details: The rate at which electricity was purchased, the quantum of electricity purchased and the quantum of electricity generated by different State Electricity Boards (SEBs) electricity Departments (EDs) in the country during 1998-99 are given in Annexure. Data for the year 2002-03 is not yet available and will be compiled after the year is over.

records.title: Growth rate for Tenth Five Year Plan
details: The Tenth five year Plan (2002-07) which would contain the State-wise growth target, is yet to be approved by the National Development Council

records.title: Prosecution of criminals
details: Supplementary by Member regarding amending the evidence act by allowing a new methology to get evidence through technological means , it was stated that the suggestions will be considered sympathically .

records.title: Foreign investment in information and broadcasting sector
details: The information regarding the total work of foreign capital investment proposal approved till the end of March,2002 in the Information and Broadcasting Sector and the actual amount of capital investment made there from is being collected.

records.title: Professional courses by foreign universities
details: The relevent information in respect of huge amount of fees being charged from students by the Western International Universities of USA, the fees prescribed for different coursewise and whether these courses have been accorded officials recognition in the country is being collected and will be laid on the Table of the House.

records.title: Decline in basic amenities in metropolitan cities
details: National Institute of Urban Affairs has interest in study to access the status of water supply, senitation and solid waste managements in 300 cities and towns including the metropolitan cities . the report is yet to be finalised.

records.title: FDI in print media
details: The Government is in the process of making guidelines for the implementation of the decision taken by the Cabinet for allowing FDI in print media.

records.title: Foreign exchange earned by shipping industry
details: The Shipping Industry has earned net foreign excahgne of Rs.3534.50 crore during the year 1999-2000 and Rs.4673.89 crore during 2000-01. The details of foreign exchange for 2001-02 are being compiled.

records.title: Pricing fixation of fertilizers
details: Formulation of policy parameters/norms for the 7th and 8th Pricing periods under the Retention Price-cum-Subsidy Scheme is under consideration of the Government.. The policy will be announced as soon as it is approved byt he competent authority.

records.title: Investigation against officers in DD
details: The detailed information regarding investigations carreid out against various offices of Doordarshan on account of allegations of corruption against them, and whether these officers are still holding different posts is being collected and will be laid on the table of the House.

records.title: Entertaining programmes on DD
details: The information regarding the average number of entertaining programmes telecast on Doordarshan during the last 3 years, and of those programmes how many produced by employees/artists in Govenment studios and number of those programmes which were got produced by outside agencies together with the payment of made therefor is being collected and will be laid on the Table of the House.

records.title: Cases investigated by CBI on Telecasting of DD Programmes
details: The information regarding the total number of cases related with the programme being telecast by Doordarshan which are under investigation by CBI and the number of cases in which investigation has been compelted and also the number of cases in which prove of conviction has been established is being collected and will be laid on the Table of the House.

records.title: Retrenchment in DDA
details: No decision to reduce the number of employees in DDA has been taken. However, a proposal for rationalisation of posts is under consideration.

records.title: Foreign Visits by Educational/Literary/Cultural Delegations
details: The information regarding the number of educational literary and cultural delegations who made foreign visits from March 1998 to December,2001 and the name of country visited by them and the number of Government employees and private citizen who acocmpanied delegations is beign collected and will be laid on the Table of the House.

records.title: Decline in export of labour intensive goods
details: The information regarding the news-item captioned `Export of labour intensive goods decline` appeared in the Financial Express dated 21st Nov.,2001,and other relevent details thereof is being collected and will be laid on the table of the House.

records.title: Tarapore Committee on UTI
details: The findings of the committee indicate certain `imprudent` investment decisions by UTI. The findings are, inter-alia, that UTI has not yet documented a comprehensive investment policy and the laid-down procedures have on occasions not been followed. Government is examining the report and has sought comments of the UTI.

records.title: White paper on Pakistan`s Nefarious activities in India
details: Various aspects involved in bringing out a White Ppaer on Pak sponsored terrorism in India are presently under consideration of the Govt.

records.title: Percentage of conviction
details: The information regarding the percentage of persons convicted by courts being 6.8 percent and in rest of the 93.2 percent of the cases the charge-sheeted persons being acquitted by the courts and Government`s information in this regard is being collected and will be laid on the Table of the House.

records.title: CBI inquiry against the officers of DD
details: The information regarding the names of officers of Doordarshan against CBI is conducting inquiry alongwith their posts and charges levelled against each of them and number of officers out of them still working in Doordarshan is being collected and will be laid on the Table of the House.

records.title: Telecasting of programmes by Prasar Bharati
details: The details regarding total number of programmes produced by the employees of Prasar Bharati and telecast on each channels during the last six months and number of such programmes telecast by prasar Bharati after their production by other institutions are being collected and wil lbe laid on the Table of the House.

records.title: Court cases regarding irregularities committed by Prasar Bharati
details: The information regarding the cases of irregularities filed in the High Court of the country of against Prasar Bharati and the relevant details in this regard is being collected and will be laid on the Table of the House.

records.title: Assessment of landing price of crude oil
details: The informationr regarding assessment of landing price of crude oil at the court of the country and items on which expenditure is made during the transaction and the extend of the expenditure is being collected and will be laid on the Table of the House.

records.title: Taxes on petro-products
details: Minister of Petroleum & Natural Gas has appealed to all the Chief Ministers for suitbale reduction in the rates of sales tax in their respective States. In response Govt. of Goa has reduced sales tax on petrol and diesel by 3% on 15.11.2000. The Govt. of Karnataka and Maharashtra has responded unfavourably. Response from others is awaited and the matter is being pursued.

records.title: CBI raids
details: CBI has informed that during the raids on the offices and residences of officials of Prasar Bharati and private television in connection with the probe into the alleged bunglign in allotment of television rights of cricket matches since 1996 has seized certain incriminating documents/articles and are presently under scrutiny and investigation.

records.title: Readymade Gaments Sector
details: The Government have constituted a Group of Ministers to formulate an integrated and balanced package of policy measures necessary to strengthen the SSI Sector.The issues are still under consideration of the Group of Ministers.

records.title: Announcement of National Textile Policy
details: Govt. would soon announce the new Textile Policy drafted on the basis of over all trade policy reforms and taking into consideraiton the report of the Sathyam Committee which widely consulted various trade organisations, labour unions, representatives of various sectors of textile industry, trade bodies, State govt. etc. before finalising its recommendations. However, no time frame has been set.

records.title: Railways projects under construction
details: The information regarding the on-going railway projects in different parts of the country and their latest status is being collected and will be laid on the Table of the House.

records.title: Re-entry of institutional land by L&DO in Delhi
details: The information regarding the number of institutional lands in Delhi which have been re-entered by his Department alongwith the details of their names, the year of re-entry and the arrears of lease money/demages due against each is being collected and will be laid on the Table of the House.

records.title: Subletting of covered area by NGOs
details: The information regarding the percentage of the covered occupied area which can be sublet by an NGO occupying the land leased to it by land and Development Office,number of NGOs who have violated the fixed norms and the names of such organisations is being collected and will be laid on the Table of the House.

records.title: Calling attention to situation arising out of Sankhya Vahini Project
details: Replying to a calling attention regarding the share holding pattern of GUNet and IUNet and the the Carnegie Mellon holding a majority voting interest in GUNet it was stated that the information will be made available.

records.title: Construction of power generation projects
details: The information regarding the estimate of the amount required for completion of construction of all the power generation projects under construction in December 1999and the source through which the amount is received together with the amount likely to be received through each source is being collected and will be laid on the Table of the House.

records.title: Payment of minimum wages
details: Amendments to the Minimum Wages Act are under consideration to make it more effective.

records.title: Delay in translocation of Asiatic Lions from Gir Forest
Penalty on bank deposits during Demonetisation
CSR complying companies
details: Based on scrutiny, preliminary notices have been issued to 5382 companies for financial year 2015-16.

records.title: Expenditure on Advertisement
details: The information is being collected and will be laid on the Table of the House

records.title: Ending of social subsidies by Railways
details: NIPFP had submitted a Report on Social Service Obligations of IR dated 28-11-2017. The report is under consideration

records.title: Fake voters
details: The information is being collected and will be laid on the Table of the House.

records.title: Pension accounts linked with aadhar
details: The information is being collected and will be placed on the table of the House.

records.title: Study Group on royalty on coal and lignite
details: A Study Group was constituted on 21.07.2014 headed by Additional Secretary (Coal) along with representatives from Ministry of Mines, Ministry of Power, Federation of Indian Chambers of Commerce and Industry (FICCI), Federation of Indian Mineral Industries (FIMI), Coal PSUs etc. for the purpose of examining the issue of revision of present royalty rates on coal and lignite. The Study Group had earlier submitted its recommendation on 27.04.2016, however, pursuant to the change in scenario due to implementation of GST and other factors, the matter was again referred to the Study Group for reconsideration of its recommendation. The final recommendation of the Study Group is awaited.

records.title: Effect of Demonetisation on Toll collection
details: The compensation to toll operators for loss incurred due to suspension of fee collection is under consideration

records.title: Salaries through digital system in schools
details: The information from the States/UTs in this regard is being collected

records.title: Permission for production of B.T.Cotton on commercial level in Andhra Pradesh and Maharashtra.
details: The Performance Reports of B.T.Cotton hybrids from the State Departments of Agriculture of Maharashtra ,Gujarat ,Madhya pradesh, Karnataka ,Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu have not yet been received.

records.title: Capital investment for development of communication system
details: The information regarding the extent of investment made during the last decade as well as at the outset of the decade of 90s and the position of same as on March,2003 ,for the development of communication system in the country and the number of people provided with employment owing to the growing capital investment is being collected and will be laid on the Table of the House.

records.title: Controvery over application of POTA in U.P.
details: Supplementary by Member regarding the setting up of Central Review Committee for POTA , it was stated that the suggestions would be considered.

records.title: Recovery of direct taxes
details:
Figures regarding the quantum of customs duty collected by the end of September,2002 will be collected and laid on the Table of the House.
The information on recovery of direct and indirect taxes through settlement of pending disputes is being collected and will be laid on the Table of the House.

records.title: PMGSY
details: The number of Habitations covered by roads constructed under Pradhan Mantri Gram Sarak Yojana is under compilation.

records.title: Permission to trading institutions for Agriculture Sector
details: The information regarding permission given to major Indian and foreign trading companies for agriculture sector, total number of such Indian as well as foreign companies and the amount of domestic and foreign capital investment made by each company is being collected and will be laid on the Table of the House.

records.title: Corruption cases pending in various courts
details: The information regarding High Courts is not readily available. The requisite information in respect of corruption cases pending in High Courts is being collected and will be laid on the Table of the House.

records.title: Expenditure on research and analysis in agriculture sector
details: Efforts are being made with the concerned Department in the Government for larger alloction of funds for agricultural research. The reply is awaited from the concerned Department.

records.title: Unutilised railway land
details: Information regarding Zone-wise details of land lying unutilised is being collected and will be laid on the Table of the Sabha.

records.title: Permission to flour mills to import wheat
details: CONSUMER AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION

The information regarding the permission to flour mills in the country to import wheat despite availibility of adequate quantity in the country is being collected and will be laid on the Table of the House.

records.title: Connecting villages by roads
details: The Central Govt. are, at present, engaged in formulating a National Rural Connecitivity Programme and have set up a National Rural Road Development Committee whose Report is awaited.

records.title: Setting up of independent broadcasting authorities
details: To deal with all the issues a broadcast law is under consideration.

records.title: Advice of CVC to take action against some Ministers
details: Non acceptance of advice of CVC by Ministries/Deptts. is reflected in the annual report of the Commission. The annual report for the year 1998 has not yet been received from the Central Vigilance Commission.

records.title: Right of information to general public
details: The report submitted by a working group on right to information and promotion of open and transparent Govt. is under consideration.

records.title: Report on citizens` right to information
details: The recommendations of the working group for legislation of the freedom of information Bill is at an advanced stage of consideraiton.

records.title: Economic crisis in financial institutions
details: The information regarding the names of Govenrment and non-government financial instituions which have fallen into severe economic crisis and the amount given to each institutions and the actual capital of each institutions at the beginning of April, 2003 is being collected and will be laid on the Table of the House.

records.title: Communal clashed in the country
details: Supplementary by Member regarding whether Trishul will be banned under the arms act it was stated that the matter would be considered.

records.title: Irrelevant laws
details: The information regarding the Committee recommending abrogation of certain irrelevant laws ,Govt. decisions thereon is being collected and will be laid on the Table of the House.
